description: Set absolute zoom ratio on a Tail 2 (1.0–12.0 — twelve x, six times the Tiny 2's range; scale is the camera's own ratio, not a magnification multiple). speed 1–10 is REQUIRED by the firmware and defaults to 5. Zoom ramps mechanically; the tool polls the readback and returns settled:false if it hadn't arrived within ~5s — the command was still sent. Hardware-verified 2026-09-26.
name: obsbot_tail2_zoom
